text:
sanjay: seeing sustained queue growth and token latency on us-central2-dedicated since ~00:12 UTC. pod evictions on r5 racks, lots of kernel NIC errors in node logs. putting this here in case we need to move traffic to hosted.
tess_oncall: thanks — are we seeing provider network flaps or instance-level NIC faults? any QA on host metrics? :eyes:
sanjay: kernel dmesg spam: 
```
[00:11:48] enx0: link is up, 10000Mbps full-duplex
[00:11:50] enx0: link is down
[00:11:51] enx0: link is up
[00:12:03] eth0: tx timeout
```
nodes in rack-5-1 repeatedly flapping. evictions ~80/min.
elaine: ops-bot alert just fired: "eviction-rate > 50/min for pool us-central2-dedicated" — copied events.
ops-bot: automated alert: region=us-central2 pool=dedicated evictions=82 rate=1.37/s replicas_affected=24. Suggested action: divert low-priority traffic to hosted and start graceful drain of affected nodes.
ryan: agree. can we shift low-pri orgs first and keep high-pri on-dedicated? set weight for dedicated -> 0.3 and hosted -> 0.7 for us-central2 routing.
sanjay: I can run the weight change. patching route policy now.
sanjay: `curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"us-central2","weights":{"dedicated":0.3,"hosted":0.7},"target":"low-priority-first"}'`
tess_oncall: do it slowly — 5% steps every 30s and watch queue length + p99 latency. keep me updated.
sanjay: starting step 1 -> dedicated 0.28 hosted 0.72
sanjay: step 3 -> dedicated 0.20 hosted 0.80. queue length dropping ~45% in 2m, evictions down to 30/min.
elaine: enabling runbook flag to mark affected machines as draining to avoid new allocations: `/runbook/infra/drain-dedicated-rack5` executed.
ryan: can we enable fallback for shortrunning jobs only? want to avoid moving long context sessions mid-gen.
sanjay: added policy to route short sessions (<=512 tokens) to hosted; long sessions get sticky to current dedicated node until completion. applied via configmap: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  routing.policy: |
    - match: {session_length: "<=512"}
      route: hosted
    - match: {session_length: ">512"}
      route: dedicated
```
ops-bot: note: reroute will increase hosted cost projection by ~12% for the next 3 hours. Billing alert threshold not breached yet.
tess_oncall: cost OK for now, prioritized uptime. keep an eye. set a rollback point if evictions stop and latency normalizes.
sanjay: evictions at 12/min, p99 latency back to baseline for most orgs. continuing drains on rack-5-1.
ryan: plan to reprovision replacement nodes in that rack tomorrow morning, but leave remaining traffic on hosted until we verify kernel NIC firmware patch.
elaine: raising ticket with provider for rack-5-1 hardware and requesting NIC firmware update. ticket #PROV-4721.
infra-runbook-bot: runbook step completed: fallback-routing enacted. ETA for full return = unknown; continue monitoring.
tess_oncall: great work. next steps: keep routing at hosted=0.8 for 15m, then evaluate. notify #incidents if any regressions. :thumbsup:
